criteria.name: Requirements Coverage
criteria.notes: All 7 in-scope requirements from step1_requirements.json have corresponding API endpoints

criteria.name: Edge Case Coverage
criteria.notes: 422/404/500 defined for all endpoints. Stale cache returns 200+warnings per AC-3, not 409 — design decision explicitly documented

criteria.name: Internal Consistency
criteria.notes: All field names, types, and optionality consistent across OpenAPI YAML, Pydantic models, and TypeScript types

criteria.name: Assumption Transparency
criteria.notes: bearerAuth documented as placeholder; /api/v1 versioning explicit; pagination not applicable to POC scope

criteria.name: Error Path Coverage
criteria.notes: All validation, not-found, and internal error paths have ErrorResponse schemas with machine-readable codes

criteria.name: Anti-Hardcoding
criteria.notes: Server URL parameterized; schemas use step1b fixture data only; MSW handlers use pattern matching

criteria.name: Cross-Step Alignment
criteria.notes: All 12 acceptance criteria from step7_atdd_orchestration.py reflected in contract; ScanResult and SyncResult dataclasses fully mirrored

criteria.name: Domain Appropriateness
criteria.notes: Paths and schema names use SBOM domain terminology (purl, cpe, cvss_score, cve_id, vex)

clarifications.issue: User prompt specifies 409 for stale NVD cache, but ATDD spec AC-3 requires scan to complete with warnings
clarifications.resolution: Implemented as HTTP 200 with non-empty warnings[] field. 409 is a conflict error and would be misleading for a non-aborting condition. Documented explicitly in contract_summary.md and OpenAPI description.
